checks: Native tangents and stroke caps/joins persist
Anticipation, impact and recovery observed at native rate
Masks, clipping and layer order persist
Observe parallax, occlusion and focus without assuming 3D
Observe surface and lighting coherence; glow alone is insufficient
Softness and height response remain coherent during motion
Observe mobile legibility and complete wordmark during transitions
Verify cuts, envelopes, synchronization and exported signal
Perceptual balance and integration require actual listening

extensionPolicy: Isolate implementation defect, incorrect use or absent capability. Integrate another engine only for a demonstrated unmet need; qualify it before quality claims. Never silently substitute a different visual operation.

exercises.goal: Bring an element into view and let it settle on the intended accent.
exercises.counterexample: A fast linear entry stops abruptly or moves the object around the wrong pivot.
exercises.parameterChange: Delay the accent five frames while keeping the final position and the reading hold.
exercises.transfer: Apply the timing to a different shape with an off-center visual mass.
exercises.evidence: Inspect keys and pivot. Measure frame positions across arrival and verify the hold after reopening.

exercises.goal: Use an animated edge to reveal a complete product silhouette.
exercises.counterexample: A successful mask call leaves a rectangular slab or obscures the part that identifies the product.
exercises.parameterChange: Reverse reveal direction while preserving the final visible region.
exercises.transfer: Use existing product artwork with a different size and crop.
exercises.evidence: Measure or inspect the visible region at onset, crossing and completion in both preview and export.

exercises.goal: Emphasize a word and preserve one stable reading beat.
exercises.counterexample: Default anchors crop letters or text remains moving for the whole reading window.
exercises.parameterChange: Change the word and font weight while retaining the visual center.
exercises.transfer: Recompose a longer two-line headline within the vertical frame.
exercises.evidence: Resolve actual font, measure text bounds and review the first/last readable frames at mobile size.

exercises.goal: Align a visual hit with a sound and taper the gain through the following action.
exercises.counterexample: The command reports success while the exported audio stays flat or the hit is displaced after trimming.
exercises.parameterChange: Lower the second hit by 6 dB and retain the onset positions.
exercises.transfer: Repeat with a different source and frame rate, keeping the visual and audio offsets in one timebase.
exercises.evidence: Compare rendered timestamps and gain. Record actual playback observations for perceptual judgment.

briefs.instruction: Reveal the provided headline in two beats. One word lands on the supplied audio marker. Use a stable readable hold after the accent.
criteria: Complete readable headline at mobile width

briefs.instruction: Make a moving edge reveal the supplied product, then let its identifying detail hold while the supporting copy enters.
criteria: Identifying detail is legible after crossing

briefs.instruction: Use movement in the final frame of the first asset to connect into the second asset. Keep geometry and direction coherent through the cut.
criteria: No accidental flash or frozen frames
Cut can be revised and exported

creativeAcceptance.measurement: Use identical starting material and limits for baseline and current flows. Record first useful preview time, interventions, measured cost, project reopen and export. Randomize candidates for human review.
creativeAcceptance.gate: Technical pass in all three briefs and blind preference for the current flow in at least two.
